title: 3x+1 Minus the +
notes: Discrete Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science 5 (2002), 47-54. NOT READ -- dmtcs.episciences.org is egress-blocked in this container, as is every other route tried. Registered 20 September 2026 as the prior art of knight-2026-small-collatz-rule. ATTESTED, NOT OBSERVED: via Conway's FRACTRAN it constructs a rule that simulates the Collatz map using MULTIPLICATION ONLY, eliminating the +1, at the cost of 1021020 conditions. Note 1021020 = 2^2 * 3 * 5 * 7 * 11 * 13 * 17, a primorial-shaped modulus, which is consistent with a residue construction but is this laboratory's arithmetic observation and not the paper's. WHY IT IS HERE. The Juggler map is ALREADY addition-free -- J(n) = floor(sqrt n) on evens and floor(n^(3/2)) on odds, with no +1 anywhere -- and J-juggler-is-collatz-one-exponential-up is the claim that it is Collatz one exponential up. So Monks and Knight are COMPETING addition-free models of the same dynamics, and the comparison is sharp: they buy the removal of the +1 by ENLARGING THE STATE SPACE (FRACTRAN residues, a million conditions, then thirty); the Juggler buys it by MOVING TO THE EXPONENT and paying a FLOOR. Both trade the +1 for something. Which trade is cheaper, and whether the two constructions meet, is an open comparison this laboratory has never made. Do not cite for anything until read.
